proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ F τ σ hτ hσ
  exact ⟨hτ.min hσ, hτ.max hσ, hτ.add hσ⟩
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (τ σ : Ω → WithTop ℕ), MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F τ → MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F σ → MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F (fun ω => min (τ ω) (σ ω)) ∧ MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F (fun ω => max (τ ω) (σ ω)) ∧ MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime F (fun ω => τ ω + σ ω)
